description: Create up to 500 agent inboxes in one call. Send `inboxes`, a list of the same fields create_agent_inbox takes. The answer has one entry in `results` for each address, in the order you sent them: `created`, `existing` (you already had it) or `refused`, with the `error` that create_agent_inbox would have answered for that address. One refused address does not stop the others. The call itself fails, and nothing is made, when your plan has no room for all the addresses that would be made (402 PLAN_GATE) or when the key may not create inboxes (403). An address twice in one call is refused the second time (400 `inboxDuplicateInBatch`). Every address you send counts toward the 1,000 a day a workspace can ask for, the refused ones too (429).

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

address.description: The whole address, such as support@agents.acme.com, on an active agent-inbox domain of yours.

displayName.description: The name people see beside the address. Left out: made from the part before the @.

label.description: A word or two to group and find inboxes, such as client-acme. Null takes it off.

name: create_agent_inboxes
title: Create many agent inboxes
